test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Lovely calculates his profit percentage on selling price, whereas Bunty calculates his on the cost price. They find that the difference in their profits is Rs. 100. If their selling price is the same, and both of them get a profit of 25%, then what is the selling price?
solution: Given: Lovely calculated his profit percentage on SP while Bunty calculated on CP. Difference in their Profits = Rs.100 SP is same for both and profit is 25% in both cases. Calculation: According to the question, Profit on SP - Profit on CP = 100
